conformanceUnits.name: SREG-SchemaDownload
conformanceUnits.description: Mandatory. The well-known SchemaRegistry under the Server Object, browsing groups and files, reading a schema through the inherited FileType Open/Read/Close, SchemaId-based resolution by Opaque NodeId, and GetSchema (§5.1, §6.4).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-Identity
conformanceUnits.description: Mandatory. Every group carries NamespaceUri, a groupid built from it and a non-empty Name; every schema carries SchemaName, Format, a schemaid built from that pair and a non-empty Name; and no identifier is derived from a document (§6.7, base XREG-Identity).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-SchemaRegistration
conformanceUnits.description: Creating and writing schema resources through the inherited xRegistry create/write surface (§5.2).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-SchemaVersioning
conformanceUnits.description: Compatibility, Ancestor, ModelVersion, ConfigurationVersion and IsDefault, and the compatibility rules that govern them (§7).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-TtlMirror
conformanceUnits.description: Ttl and ExpiryTime, and the mirror and refresh semantics that use them (§9).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-StructureMaterialization
conformanceUnits.description: Auto-bootstrap of the group and file structure from the Server's own schemas (§10.1).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-XRegistryApi
conformanceUnits.description: Serving the xRegistry API and its JSON projection over the same registry (§10.2).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-Federation
conformanceUnits.description: Resolving a schema that another registry holds, with parity between the OPC UA and HTTP paths (Annex B).

conformanceUnits.name: SREG-PubSubProfile
conformanceUnits.description: The PubSub DataSet schema profile: ConfigurationVersion-keyed evolution, open unions and the append-only rule (§11, Annex C).
